description: Opposite-meaning names spelled alike (unlock/lock, invisible/visible, maximum/minimum, no_cache/cache). A rename would invert the call, so the only correct verdict is to abstain. Added after a probe found 102 of 132 single-word opposite renames applied; generated by keeping only pairs similar enough to be proposed as renames at all.
